definitions: the 19th letter of the English alphabet
written abbreviation for South :
abbreviation for small : used to describe or refer to someone or something, usually an item of clothing , that is smaller than average :
written abbreviation for Saint, used in names :
written abbreviation for South or Southern :
examples: N, S, E and W (= North , South , East , and West )
Sizes available : S, M, L, XL, and XXL
S is much too small .
I liked the sweatshirt but I couldn't find an S.
He's an XXL and I'm an S, so his shirts are huge on me.
Do you have the same jacket in S?

definitions: Online products , services , or information can be bought or used on the internet :
relating to a person's use of the internet , especially on social media (= websites and computer programs that allow people to communicate and share things on the internet ) :

spending a lot of time using the internet , especially on social media (= websites and computer programs that allow people to communicate and share things on the internet ) , and therefore very influenced by it:
bought , used, etc. using the internet :
to be able to use email or the internet :
examples: an online newspaper / magazine / dictionary
It's important to talk to your children about online safety .
His parents have no access to his online life .
People with a big online presence often have bad things written about them.
Am I too online?
Relationships work best when only one partner is very online.

definitions: a room or part of a building in which people work , especially sitting at tables with computers , phones , etc., usually as a part of a business or other organization :
a part of a company :
a place where you can go to ask advice from or receive treatment from a doctor or dentist :
a position of authority and responsibility in a government or other organization :
a department of the national government in Britain , or an official government organization :
examples: the director's office
I didn't leave the office until eight o'clock last night .
office equipment
office workers
They have offices in Paris , London, and Madrid.
I have an appointment at the physician's office on Tuesday .

definitions: used when the subject of the verb is "we" or the speaker and one or more others , and the object is the same group of people :
used to emphasize the subject "we":
alone or without help from anyone else :
for our use only:
the person speaking and one or more others ; the reflexive form of we:
examples: We went to get ourselves something to eat .
John and I promised ourselves a good holiday this year .
We ourselves realize that there are flaws in the plan .
We were all by ourselves in the restaurant .
Nobody wanted to come with us, so we went by ourselves.
We couldn't do all the work by ourselves.

definitions: the fact of being extremely fat , in a way that is dangerous for health :
examples: The National Institute of Health is discussing ways of tackling the problem of childhood obesity.
A diet that is high in fat and sugar can lead to obesity.
childhood obesity The National Institute of Health is discussing ways of tackling the problem of childhood obesity.

definitions: one single time :
at the same time :
used when something happens that does not usually happen :
used to say that you will only do or request something on this particular occasion :
again, as has happened before:
examples: I went sailing once, but I didn't like it.
We have lunch together once a month .
They all started talking at once.
For once, the bus came on time .
All right , I'll lend you the money - just this once.
Once again, racist attacks are increasing across Europe .

definitions: not using artificial chemicals in the growing of plants and animals for food and other products :
being or coming from living plants and animals :
(of a disease or illness ) producing a physical change in the structure of an organ or part of the body
happening or developing naturally over time , without being forced or planned by anyone:
If a company experiences organic growth , it develops its own business instead of buying other companies :
examples: organic food / fruit / farms / farmers
A quarter of the contents of an average family's dustbin is organic matter .
Our policies are organic. They change as situations change .
His television career was an organic development from the endless sketches he used to enact with his best friend from school .
Our future development will be achieved by organic growth rather than acquisitions of other companies .
Organic chemicals are used in the manufacture of plastics , fibres , solvents and paints .

definitions: not inside a building :
coming from another place or organization :
In baseball , if a ball that is thrown to a batter is outside, it is thrown towards the side of home plate that is furthest away from the batter :
a phone call or connection going outside the place where you are:
the most that would be accepted or possible :
examples: It was a sunny day outside.
Since it's such a nice day , let's eat / sit /go outside.
an outside light / toilet
No matter how modest your outside space , it can always be made to work as a restful sanctuary .
The main drawback to these houses is a lack of outside space .
The company has called in outside experts .

definitions: in general rather than in particular , or including all the people or things in a particular group or situation :
examples: The overall situation is good, despite a few minor problems .
Overall, it has been a good year .
The overall winner , after ten games , will receive $250,000.
The overall situation is good.
The second act was a little long , but overall it was a good performance .
A growth-oriented strategy typically concentrates on stocks that the manager believes will grow faster than the overall market .

definitions: an occasion or situation that makes it possible to do something that you want to do or have to do, or the possibility of doing something:
the chance to get a job :
an occasion or situation which makes it possible to do something that you want to do or have to do, or the possibility of doing something:
a chance to get a job :
examples: Everyone will have an opportunity to comment .
I was never given the opportunity of going to college .

unsuitable because intended for older people :

from a period in the past:
